evidence: task.toml:5 name = "turing/kittle-matter-chat" equals turing/<dirname> for the logical slug kittle-matter-chat (projects/kittle-matter-chat exists and `diff -rq` against the frozen task is empty). Description (task.toml:6) names this product (law-firm client chat by legal matter) and its real axes: ethical walls across lists/search/posting/transcripts, disappearing-message timers, partner legal holds overriding timers, transcripts of surviving messages; these match instruction.md:1-3 and walls-and-retention.md, and 'Express and SQLite' matches integration.md:3 (Express and better-sqlite3 provided, SQLite at /app/app.db) and solution/app/package.json:8. Keywords (messaging, chat, legal, retention, express, sqlite, nodejs) and metadata agree: difficulty 'hard' with an explanation whose claims (wall across list/search/post/transcript, permanent timer deletion from stored times against a fixed clock, holds override until released, partner-only timers/holds) are each stated in walls-and-retention.md and integration.md:7; category 'Messaging & Chat Interfaces' matches tag 'messaging-chat' and arena_slice 'full-stack-express-sqlite-messaging-chat-kittle-matter-chat'; provenance 'turing/kittle-matter-chat v1.0.0' names the same task. No CHANGE_ME template residue and no other task's name (threadline/hireops/docketlight/bazaar/change-me) anywhere in the frozen task; [task].version absent, which the row note allows. Minor observation (not a defect): the description omits the conversation features (nested replies, edits, mentions, unread line, live updates) that about half of the 16 functional criteria grade; it still describes this task accurately and the omission causes no disagreement between fields. Counterexample search: metadata is not graded and not shown to the agent, so no broken app could gain from it and no conforming alternative (e.g. a non-Express Node server) is penalised by it.
